page.overview:
Who is Hei Bai?

Hei Bai served as the guardian of a forest outside Senlin Village for millennia. When the forest was destroyed, he became enraged and, unaware that the Fire Nation was responsible, began targeting Senlin Village and blaming its inhabitants. As the winter solstice approached, he shifted into his monstrous form and abducted one villager each day at sunset.

When Avatar Aang arrived, he attempted to reason with Hei Bai but was unable to calm him. Hei Bai turned violent toward Aang, prompting Sokka to intervene by striking the spirit with his boomerang. Hei Bai quickly overpowered Sokka, capturing him and carrying him into the Spirit World. Later, Aang managed to establish a connection with him, learning Hei Bai was the spirit of the forest and tried to soothe Hei Bai by showing him the acorns covering the burnt forest floor, reassuring him that the forest would eventually regrow. This pacified Hei Bai, who returned to his panda form, took an acorn in his mouth, and departed through the village gate. Bamboo sprouted from the gate, and the previously kidnapped villagers, including Sokka, emerged safely.

After Aang met with Koh, Hei Bai returned to transport him to the gateway out of the Spirit World. He shot a stream of light from his mouth toward Aang, sending him back to the physical world. When a baboon spirit made a rude remark in Aang's absence, Hei Bai momentarily transformed into his monstrous form, blasted at the spirit and scared him away, before returning to his panda shape.

Months later, when Aang was in a coma induced by Princess Azula's lightning, Hei Bai appeared again and assisted him during his journey to reconnect with his most recent past lives.
